title: Concept: Every source may serve every package id
description: nuget.config declares a nuget.config with no `<packageSourceMapping>`, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads a nuget.config with no `<packageSourceMapping>`.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through nuget.config (nuget).
risk: A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads a nuget.config with no `<packageSourceMapping>`.
